\u27e6CODE1\u27e7: ["```python title=\"mcp.py\"", "from pydantic_ai.capabilities import MCP", "from pydantic_ai.native_tools import MCPServerTool", "", "# URL-based MCP server, running locally (requires `pydantic-ai-slim[mcp]`)", "MCP('https://mcp.example.com/api')", "", "# Local client without a URL \u2014 pass any `MCPToolset` input", "# (URL, `fastmcp.Client`, transport, in-process `FastMCP` server, script path, etc.)", "MCP(local=my_fastmcp_client)", "", "# Native preferred; URL-based local fallback", "MCP('https://mcp.example.com/api', native=True)", "", "# Strict native-only (no local \u2014 does not require the `mcp` extra)", "MCP('https://mcp.example.com/api', native=True, local=False)", "", "# Explicit native + explicit local \u2014 independent configuration on each side", "# (e.g. provider-relay URL for native, direct connection for local)", "MCP(", "    native=MCPServerTool(", "        id='public-mcp',", "        url='https://relay.example.com/mcp',", "        authorization_token='relay-token',", "    ),", "    local=my_fastmcp_client,", ")", "```"]
\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python title=\"mcp_capability_per_user.py\"", "from dataclasses import dataclass", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext", "from pydantic_ai.capabilities import MCP", "", "", "@dataclass", "class Deps:", "    mcp_token: str", "", "", "def mcp_token(ctx: RunContext[Deps]) -> str:", "    return f'Bearer {ctx.deps.mcp_token}'", "", "", "agent = Agent(", "    'openai:gpt-6.1-sol',", "    deps_type=Deps,", "    capabilities=[MCP('https://mcp.example.com/api', authorization_token=mcp_token)],", ")", "", "", "async def main():", "    result = await agent.run('What is 7 plus 5?', deps=Deps(mcp_token='<token>'))", "    print(result.output)", "    #> The answer is 12.", "```"]
